points.text: light (from each slit) superposes / interferes (at screen)

when phase difference is 0 / path difference is nλ (where n is an integer) a bright fringe is formed or when phase difference is 180(°) / path difference is (n + 1)λ / 2 (where n is an integer) a dark fringe is formed
the light / beams (have different frequencies so) are not coherent / do not have constant phase difference
